definitions.explanation: The period of Japanese history when the Tokugawa shogunate ruled from Edo (modern-day Tokyo). Characterized by political stability, strict social order, isolationist foreign policy, and flourishing arts and culture.

examples.japanese: {江戸時代|えどじだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧260⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The Edo period lasted for about 260 years.

examples.japanese: {江戸時代|えどじだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鎖国|さこく}→鎖国：14514_sakoku⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧とられて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: During the Edo period, a policy of national isolation was maintained.

examples.japanese: {江戸時代|えどじだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧や⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町人|ちょうにん}→町人：13593_chounin⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{花開|はなひら}いた→花開く：14059_hanahiraku⟧。
examples.english: During the Edo period, townspeople's culture such as kabuki and ukiyo-e prints flourished.

notes:
One of the most important periods in Japanese history, spanning from 1603 when {徳川家康|とくがわいえやす} established the shogunate in ⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧ (Edo) to 1868 when the ⟦{明治維新|めいじいしん}→明治維新：16286_meijiishin⟧ (Meiji Restoration) returned power to the emperor.

KEY FEATURES:
- ⟦{鎖国|さこく}→鎖国：14514_sakoku⟧: national isolation policy limiting foreign contact
- ⟦{参勤交代|さんきんこうたい}→参勤交代：12846_sankinkoutai⟧: alternate attendance system requiring feudal lords to spend time in Edo
- {士農工商|しのうこうしょう}: four-class social hierarchy
- Flourishing of ⟦{町人|ちょうにん}→町人：13593_chounin⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (merchant-class culture): ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧, ⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧, ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {江戸時代|えどじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧: Edo-period samurai
- {江戸時代|えどじだい}⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧/⟦{中期|ちゅうき}→中期：18820_chuuki⟧/⟦{末期|まっき}→末期：13032_makki⟧: early/mid/late Edo period
- {江戸時代|えどじだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: continuing since the Edo period

- ⟦{明治時代|めいじじだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧: Meiji period — the following era of modernization
